quitDetail: You can leave new managed pipelines running and reconnect next time you open the app. Project creation will be cancelled; folders already created will be kept. Open demonstrations and agent connections will close either way. Terminals will stop; their tabs will be kept, but their processes will not restart. If a run cannot safely be kept running, the application will stay open.
